title: Riesz–Markov–Kakutani representation of a vague limit on an open set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and (ν_j)_{j∈ℕ} Borel measures on ℝ^P with ν_j(K) < ∞ for every j and every compact K ⊆ U. Suppose that for every continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and tsupport f ⊆ U the real sequence (∫ f dν_j)_j converges. Then there is a Borel measure μ on ℝ^P with μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and ∫ f dν_j → ∫ f dμ for every continuous f with compact support and tsupport f ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (νs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ (j : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → νs j K < ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(νs j)) atTop (𝓝 c)) → ∃ μ : Measure (Euclid P), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(νs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
